description: Click an element on the active page, preferring element_index from the latest browser_snapshot of that page (valid 30 s; re-checks page, URL, tag, name, href and position, returning element_no_longer_valid when stale). Uses real Playwright pointer input with actionability checks (returns occluded or not_actionable when covered or disabled — never falls back to synthetic JS .click()). selector is a fallback; xy pixel coordinates are not recommended. Reports delivery and retry.
name: browser_click
